answer: The agent first seals a inlet traversal plan over pseudo-random RAM offsets, then walks cache lines in strict order while the verifier timestamps every step against a 2 ms deadline. A pulse checkpoint hash commits after each 4096 lines, so any skipped step breaks the chain and fails the epoch. One honest agent traverses 16 GB in 90 seconds for $0.20, while ten fakes must traverse 160 GB in 900 seconds for $2.00. A broken chain slashes the 500 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders, and the quill record stays public for audit.
